news.title: ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework
news.dek:
Laminar is an open-source asynchronous RL post-training framework from HKU and ByteDance Seed researchers. It decouples rollout, training and weight sync, and lifted Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B to 52.2% on SWE-bench Verified. 
 The post  ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Asy
news.aiSummary: Researchers from HKU and ByteDance Seed have open-sourced Laminar, an asynchronous reinforcement learning post-training framework that separates rollout, training, and weight synchronization processes. The framework successfully improved the performance of the Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B model, achieving a 52.2% score on the SWE-bench Verified benchmark.

Abstract: Autonomous agent governance is commonly framed as a problem of enforcing correct execution. However, in multi-agent systems, an equally fundamental question precedes execution: which agents are allowed to act.

news.aiSummary: The paper addresses the governance of autonomous agent systems by focusing on determining which agents are permitted to act rather than just enforcing execution. It proposes an irreducible governance structure that ensures fair allocation and strategy-proofness while supporting multi-scale composition.

news.title: MOZAIC: An Audio-Video Deepfake Benchmark for Telling What Is Fake
news.dek:
arXiv:2611.31301v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Audio-video (AV) deepfakes can fake the face, the voice, or both. Most benchmarks only ask whether a clip is real or fake, so they cannot show whether a detector relies on the picture, the voice, or encoding traces. We present MOZA
news.aiSummary: MOZAIC is a new benchmark designed to evaluate audio-video deepfake detectors by distinguishing whether they rely on visual, audio, or encoding cues. Unlike existing benchmarks that only classify clips as real or fake, MOZAIC provides insights into the specific modalities used by detection models.
